title: How to Beat Kuldra - Complete Raid Guide | Dragonwilds 1.0
author: SuperStooob
description:
Need a RuneScape Dragonwilds server to play with friends? Check out berrybyte and use STOOOB20 for 20% off!

Complete Kuldra Raid Guide for RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0! This full Scorned Wilderness walkthrough covers every checkpoint, anima puzzle, boss encounter, the full Kuldra fight, preparation, new materials and rewards.


In this guide I'll show you:

• Where to start the Scorned Wilderness raid
• The best gear, food and potions to bring
• How raid checkpoints work
• Runite, Luminite and the new crafting materials
• Dragontail Vines walkthrough
• Fragments of Ghornfell walkthrough
• Shattered Stronghold walkthrough
• Cataclysm Keep walkthrough
• Every important Anima puzzle
• The Air, Water, Earth & Fire puzzle solution
• How to use Anima Orbs and Pylons
• How to beat the Plague King and other raid enemies
• The complete Kuldra boss fight
• Every Kuldra phase and attack
• How the Resonator mechanic works
• How to survive Kuldra's Hyper Beam
• The final phase inside Kuldra
• Kuldra rewards and Dragon gear

00:46 Preparation & What to Bring
02:38 How Raid Checkpoints Work
03:25 Rune, Vis Cloth & New Materials
04:59 Dragontail Vines

07:30 Fragments of Ghornfell
08:49 Maze & Poison Section
10:40 Plague King & Abyssal Demon
11:47 Shattered Stronghold
13:01 Cataclysm Keep
13:22 Four Anima Pylon Puzzle
14:33 Air, Water, Earth, Fire Solution
14:45 Kuldra Boss Fight
16:47 Kuldra Phase 2
17:15 Kuldra Phase 3
17:51 Inside Kuldra – Final Phase
19:23 Kuldra Rewards & Dragon Gear
20:08 Final Thoughts


A few quick tips before entering:
Bring plenty of Antipoison and Antifire potions, your best healing food, an Adamant Pickaxe or better, a Woodcutting Axe, and ideally access to Melee, Ranged and Magic.

You DON'T need full Rune armour to complete the raid. I cleared Kuldra primarily in Tier 7 armour, although upgrading to Rune weapons during the raid made things considerably easier.

On your first completion you'll finish Regicide and receive the Dragon Kiteshield and Dragon Slayer Cape, alongside your Kuldra reward roll. I managed to pull the Dragon Platebody on my first clear.

This is a DAY ONE guide, so if you discover a faster route, additional hidden loot, Sanguine Urns, group-specific mechanics or anything I've missed, leave it in the comments and I'll pin useful information.

RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is now available with the Scorned Wilderness, Kuldra the God-Eater, Rune gear, Dragon equipment, Wands, new combat mechanics and more.
